'''Pammel Tarqus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] who worked for the rebellious [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Grathan]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] around [[3643 BBY]], when he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]]-affiliated individual. He owned a [[vine cat]] named "[[Wraith (vine cat)|Wraith]]" and a [[Sleen/Legends|sleen]] named "[[Shadow (sleen)|Shadow]]," and was working with them in kennels in the [[Malignant Bog]].

==Behind the scenes==
Pammel Tarqus appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an Elite boss on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Dromund Kaas. He is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed by any Imperial character for loot.
